p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

ja: する。 心の直ぐな者たちの集いと、会衆の中で。
en: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

ja: 111:1 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。詩篇111篇は折句詩であり、冒頭の「主をほめたたえよ！」に続く各節は、ヘブル語のアルファベット順（アレフからタウ）に始まる。
en:
111:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 111 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
111:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

en: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
u.src: 2  The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

p.src: 3  His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

ja: の御業には誉れと威厳があり、 その
en: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
u.src: 3  His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

p.src: 4  He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

ja: み豊かで、あわれみ深い。
en: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
u.src: 4  He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

p.src: 5  He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

en: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
u.src: 5  He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

p.src: 6  He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

ja: は御業の力をご自分の
en: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
u.src: 6  He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

p.src: 7  The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

en: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
u.src: 7  The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

p.src: 8  They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

ja: それらは、とこしえのとこしえまで
en: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
u.src: 8  They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

p.src: 9  He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

ja: であり、恐るべきものである。
en: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
u.src: 9  He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

p.src: 10  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
u.src: 10  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
